recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is; no FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-12739 unless a future PA work-group decision changes the Appointment participant model.
issue_request: FHIR-12739 requested support for appointments where individual participants are involved for different periods, and its Published/Persuasive with Modification resolution was to add period [0..1] to Appointment.participant.
initial_application: The change was historically applied by commit 14d654ad0fa4d54f846b6c8ec663f6280bfe5fd5, whose subject is "GF#12739: Appointment.participant.period added" and which changed the legacy Appointment spreadsheet source. Later source rework preserved the element in source/appointment/structuredefinition-Appointment.xml.
additional_context: Appointment is active in source/fhir.ini, placing source/appointment/structuredefinition-Appointment.xml in current build scope. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later substantive or community decision that contradicts retaining Appointment.participant.period.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because source/appointment/structuredefinition-Appointment.xml already contains Appointment.participant.period with min 0, max 1, and type Period.
